footer.tagline: Simple queue management for modern businesses

home.step1Body: DoorMeen helps businesses manage queues and helps customers save time. Let us show you around!
home.step2Body: Scan a QR code to join an existing queue as a customer, or create your own queue if you run a business.
home.step3Body: In the official release, customers joining a queue will verify their identity with a PIN sent via SMS. This prevents fake entries and keeps your queue fair and secure.

create.step1Body: Set a name people can recognize and choose a secure 4–6 digit PIN. Only you will use this PIN to manage the queue.
create.step2Body: In the official release, every customer who joins your queue will receive a verification PIN via SMS. This ensures real people are in line — no ghost entries, no line-cutting.
create.step3Title: Why we ask for your email
create.step3Body: Your email lets us send you queue reports and helps verify you as the owner when full account management launches.

join.step1Body: Enter your name, phone, and email to take your place in line. You can watch your position update in real time!
join.step2Body: In the official release, you will receive a PIN via SMS to verify your spot. This guarantees nobody else can join using your number and keeps the queue fair for everyone.

queue.step1Body: Notice the ad banner on this page? Business owners can showcase their promotions right where customers are waiting. Prime visibility, real audience!
queue.step2Title: Win a FREE month of ads!
queue.step2Body: Create a queue and use it for a full day — your name and email will be entered into a draw to win one month of FREE ad space on DoorMeen!
queue.step3Body:
① Create a queue with a valid email
② Use the queue for one complete business day (serve at least one customer)
③ Your name and email automatically enter the draw

Winners are announced at the end of every month!
